name: scene_test
description: Use this if the customer complains about scenes not working, or only some of the devices are responding, or some devices respond intermittently. Returns 'summary': one {name, address, status: success|failure} entry per scene member; 'note': present only if at least one member failed; 'details': raw protocol trace, evidence only -- not a statement about the scene's configured on/off behavior. INSTEON-only for now.

group_address.description: The scene/group's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
